reasons: The candidate multiplies the result by a constant 100 that is not in the Datadog source; this changes the quantity and violates the no-invented-constants rule.
The template variable $host with tag prefix host should become a matcher host=~"$host" (default * kept as a filter), but the candidate drops it, so the series set differs from the request.
The metric mapping nginx.requests.total -> nginx.requests (monotonic sum) and the translated outcome are appropriate; the sum aggregation matches the Datadog sum.
